description: Use this when a visitor wants every ride at one supported park, or to compare rides by height requirement, length, speed or Lightning Lane. Facts vary by ride; missing facts are omitted rather than guessed.

park_id.description: Park key (magic-kingdom), canonical park ID, park name, or shorthand such as mk, epcot, hs, ak, dl, dca, usf, ioa, epic or ush. A park name works directly, with no lookup first.

name: parky_list_park_rides
title: List a park's rides
